content.short: AdaPunks are NFT collectables on the Cardano blockchain. Each AdaPunk is uniquely generated with computer algorithms, and there will only be 1,000 ever minted.
content.description: AdaPunks are NFT collectables on the Cardano blockchain. Each AdaPunk is uniquely generated with computer algorithms, and there will only be 1,000 ever minted. AdaPunks are in no way affiliated with Larva Labs and/or CryptoPunks and/or SolPunks. Rather, we wanted to create a different set of punks: punks with a limited supply of only 1,000 so we could focus on high-quality design features that differentiate them from all other blockchain punks.
